energy_accounting_review.interpretation: Original requested domain is Eelect>=0.25keV. The new CYGNO-MC export instead starts at initial energy 0.25keV per ion, so retained low-energy closure warnings remain relevant to its low-end raw points. Do not renormalize channels or erase flags.

impurity_review.confidence_note: Nominal fixed 95% paired linear-contrast intervals; adaptive repeated checks do not guarantee sequential or simultaneous coverage
impurity_review.interpretation: At sampled points in the original requested electronic-energy domain, all full-cascade paired QF contrasts resolve the nominal +/-2% criterion. This does not establish equivalence at all energies or equivalence of physical charge or all range distributions.

monotonicity_review.caveat: Post-hoc local diagnostic, not a simultaneous/sequential test or a detector calibration; raw means and original fatal flag remain unchanged.

reversals.interpretation: Strict raw monotonicity failure is retained; this difference is consistent with finite Monte Carlo statistics.

track_sampling_review.criterion: abs(mean paired fractional path change)+2*SEM <= 0.03 with a distinct smaller EXYZ increment
track_sampling_review.interpretation: All 1keV comparisons hit the same 1eV floor and provide no refinement test. At 100keV C and O do not meet the 3% diagnostic; all five pass at 1000keV. Sampled primary polylines remain lower bounds; actual primary and full-cascade path lengths are unknown.

reliability: Reproducible nominal electronic-energy prediction; not best-possible, low-energy-cutoff-converged, derivative-qualified or charge-calibrated.
